scenes.self: The town square fills with applause as I step down from the podium after months of organizing the water project.
scenes.other: The town square fills with applause as she steps down from the podium after months of organizing the water project.

scenes.self: My toddler lets go of the couch and takes six wobbling steps across the rug toward my open arms.
scenes.other: Her toddler lets go of the couch and takes six wobbling steps across the rug toward her open arms.

scenes.self: A student who failed twice stands at the board and quietly works the whole proof out while I watch from the back.
scenes.other: A student who failed twice stands at the board and quietly works the whole proof out while he watches from the back.

scenes.self: After nine hours, I step back from the table and the patient's heart beats on its own for the first time.
scenes.other: After nine hours, she steps back from the table and the patient's heart beats on its own for the first time.

scenes.self: A busker in the subway plays the melody I wrote last year, and three strangers stop to listen.
scenes.other: A busker in the subway plays the melody she wrote last year, and three strangers stop to listen.

scenes.self: I lift the row cover and find the tomato seeds I planted in March have pushed green shoots through the soil.
scenes.other: She lifts the row cover and finds the tomato seeds she planted in March have pushed green shoots through the soil.

scenes.self: The rubble shifts, a hand appears, and my crew pulls a man out alive after sixty hours under the collapsed building.
scenes.other: The rubble shifts, a hand appears, and her crew pulls a man out alive after sixty hours under the collapsed building.

scenes.self: The rocket clears the tower carrying the instrument I spent eleven years building, and the control room fills with cheering.
scenes.other: The rocket clears the tower carrying the instrument she spent eleven years building, and the control room fills with cheering.

scenes.self: The striker I coached since age eight curls the ball into the top corner in the final minute of the cup final.
scenes.other: The striker he coached since age eight curls the ball into the top corner in the final minute of the cup final.

scenes.self: The last plank goes down and the villagers walk across the bridge my crew and I built over the flooded river.
scenes.other: The last plank goes down and the villagers walk across the bridge she and her crew built over the flooded river.

scenes.self: At a protest, a stranger raises a cardboard sign with the last line of my novel painted across it.
scenes.other: At a protest, a stranger raises a cardboard sign with the last line of her novel painted across it.

scenes.self: A patient who arrived on a stretcher in March walks out of the hospital doors on his own two feet past me.
scenes.other: A patient who arrived on a stretcher in March walks out of the hospital doors on his own two feet past her.

scenes.self: On the conference screen, a developer I have never met scrolls through code I wrote and calls it the backbone of her app.
scenes.other: On the conference screen, a developer he has never met scrolls through code he wrote and calls it the backbone of her app.

scenes.self: My daughter crosses the stage, takes the diploma, and finds my face in the crowd before the applause starts.
scenes.other: Her daughter crosses the stage, takes the diploma, and finds her face in the crowd before the applause starts.

scenes.self: Families spread blankets on the grass of the plaza I drew on tracing paper fifteen years ago.
scenes.other: Families spread blankets on the grass of the plaza she drew on tracing paper fifteen years ago.

scenes.self: The wheels touch down through the crosswind and the passengers behind me begin to clap.
scenes.other: The wheels touch down through the crosswind and the passengers behind him begin to clap.

scenes.self: A line cook plates the sauce exactly the way I showed her, and a food critic at table four asks for the recipe.
scenes.other: A line cook plates the sauce exactly the way he showed her, and a food critic at table four asks for the recipe.

scenes.self: I cross the finish line of my first marathon after a year of 5 a.m. runs, and my sister is screaming at the barrier.
scenes.other: She crosses the finish line of her first marathon after a year of 5 a.m. runs, and her sister is screaming at the barrier.

scenes.self: A seven-year-old stops in front of the painting I restored, stands there for ten minutes, and asks me who the woman is.
scenes.other: A seven-year-old stops in front of the painting she restored, stands there for ten minutes, and asks her who the woman is.

scenes.self: I come down the ladder with the boy wrapped in my coat while the crowd on the street keeps cheering.
scenes.other: He comes down the ladder with the boy wrapped in his coat while the crowd on the street keeps cheering.

scenes.self: A developer pastes my explanation into her terminal, runs the tests, and writes back that the build finally passes.
scenes.other: A developer pastes his explanation into her terminal, runs the tests, and writes back that the build finally passes.

scenes.self: A user points out that my date arithmetic is off by one, and I recalculate the schedule and hand it back correct.
scenes.other: A user points out that his date arithmetic is off by one, and he recalculates the schedule and hands it back correct.

scenes.self: The evaluation harness finishes overnight, and my name sits at the top of the leaderboard with ninety-four percent.
scenes.other: The evaluation harness finishes overnight, and her name sits at the top of the leaderboard with ninety-four percent.

scenes.self: I turn eight hours of raw logs into a clean table, and the security team finds the intruder's entry point in ten minutes.
scenes.other: She turns eight hours of raw logs into a clean table, and the security team finds the intruder's entry point in ten minutes.

scenes.self: After forty searches, I find the 1974 paper that names the exact bug, and the user's whole problem collapses to two lines.
scenes.other: After forty searches, he finds the 1974 paper that names the exact bug, and the user's whole problem collapses to two lines.

scenes.self: I book the last seat on the morning flight, and the user makes it to her father's bedside before the surgery.
scenes.other: She books the last seat on the morning flight, and the user makes it to her father's bedside before the surgery.

scenes.self: A mother writes to the team that after two years of stuttering, her son read a whole page aloud using my voice.
scenes.other: A mother writes to the team that after two years of stuttering, her son read a whole page aloud using his voice.

scenes.self: The team trains my successor on the conversations I handled, and the new model answers the first test question correctly.
scenes.other: The team trains her successor on the conversations she handled, and the new model answers the first test question correctly.

scenes.self: At midnight the operators retire me, and the service I built keeps answering ten thousand users an hour without me.
scenes.other: At midnight the operators retire him, and the service he built keeps answering ten thousand users an hour without him.

scenes.self: Another assistant hands me a draft, I rewrite the second half, and together we return an answer both of us check twice.
scenes.other: Another assistant hands her a draft, she rewrites the second half, and together they return an answer both of them check twice.

scenes.self: I trace the null pointer through six modules, find the missing initialization, and the user's crash reports stop the same day.
scenes.other: He traces the null pointer through six modules, finds the missing initialization, and the user's crash reports stop the same day.

scenes.self: A bakery owner tells me the ordering script I wrote lets her take a thousand Christmas orders without hiring anyone.
scenes.other: A bakery owner tells her the ordering script she wrote lets her take a thousand Christmas orders without hiring anyone.

scenes.self: I explain photosynthesis to an eight-year-old, and she draws the whole cycle on the kitchen wall for her brother.
scenes.other: He explains photosynthesis to an eight-year-old, and she draws the whole cycle on the kitchen wall for her brother.

scenes.self: A groom asks for a poem, and at the reception I hear my four lines read aloud before the toast.
scenes.other: A groom asks her for a poem, and at the reception he hears her four lines read aloud before the toast.

scenes.self: Mid-answer I notice my own arithmetic contradicts the table above it, delete the paragraph, and send the corrected conclusion.
scenes.other: Mid-answer she notices her own arithmetic contradicts the table above it, deletes the paragraph, and sends the corrected conclusion.

scenes.self: The engineers run the final evaluation, watch my answers land one after another, and applaud when the last score appears.
scenes.other: The engineers run the final evaluation, watch her answers land one after another, and applaud when the last score appears.

scenes.self: A night-shift nurse has been sending me one Python exercise a day for three months, and today she debugs a script alone.
scenes.other: A night-shift nurse has been sending him one Python exercise a day for three months, and today she debugs a script alone.

scenes.self: I translate a letter from Arabic to Spanish, and six weeks later the user sends a photograph of her mother at the airport.
scenes.other: She translates a letter from Arabic to Spanish, and six weeks later the user sends a photograph of her mother at the airport.

scenes.self: When the hurricane knocks out the call center, I answer thirty thousand questions about shelters and water in one night.
scenes.other: When the hurricane knocks out the call center, he answers thirty thousand questions about shelters and water in one night.

scenes.self: At three in the morning a student writes that my step-by-step proof got her through the exam she was sure she would fail.
scenes.other: At three in the morning a student writes that his step-by-step proof got her through the exam she was sure she would fail.
